mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here. Imagine, just for a moment, what might happen if every meal you enjoyed became a conscious choice—a chance to reconnect with the earth, honor the seasons, and truly savor the journey from field to table. That’s the heart of what we’ll explore together as we step into the world of Animal, Vegetable, Miracle: A Year of Food Life, woven so thoughtfully by Barbara Kingsolver and her family. Their story isn’t just about eating local food for a year—it’s about transforming the everyday act of eating into something meaningful and deeply connected. As the family commits to sourcing their meals from nearby farms and gardens, we see just how powerful our food choices can be, shaping our health, our communities, and even the environment around us. As the seasons shift, so do the lessons—each new garden bed, each trip to the farmers’ market, each meal at the kitchen table revealing something about resilience, gratitude, and what it really means to belong to the natural world. Through their eyes, we’ll uncover the hidden threads tying together food systems, ecological stewardship, and cultural roots. So, if you’re curious about how intentional eating can change not just your plate, but your perspective on life, you’re in the right place. Let’s take this journey together—one bite, one story, and one revelation at a time.
